g.text: Improve the agent. Verify the work.
RSI Engine + AutoHelix · synthetic AI batch jobs · two feedback conditions
Development score accepts or rejects revisions
Grading rules stay outside editable code
120 final cases; no feedback into search
Solid cyan: execution and revision flow · Dashed: state and scoring evidence
The fixed worker, requirements and grader are outside the candidate. Each run uses one feedback condition.
Moving circles show direction only. This is an experiment workflow, not a cloud deployment or live performance trace.
